notes: Code generated with AI assistance (Claude). Reviewed by team. Rooms of the Center Campus facility, side by side along x (metres). Each room's id is sent to StoryTriggers.enter_area() when the player walks in. 'floor' and 'wall' are hex colours (60s palette). mission_control_scene is where the Launch Office sends a cleared rocket; if it does not exist yet the office says so. Text the rooms show lives here so it can be rewritten without code.

rooms.name: DESIGN BAY
rooms.subtitle: Click a part on a shelf, then click the rocket to fit it.

rooms.name: WIND TUNNEL
rooms.subtitle: Press E at the control desk to blow air over a model of your rocket.

rooms.name: IBM COMPUTER ROOM
rooms.subtitle: Press E at the keypunch to type your rocket in real numbers.

rooms.name: LAUNCH OFFICE
rooms.subtitle: Press E at the console to request a launch.
